changed: Empty screens now look and read the same, and say how to add the first item or where entries come from: Custom fields, Shorthands, Saved snippets, Tags, Authors, Sources, Other devices, the program matrix and the Upgrade figures screen. Screen readers announce the heading.

When a screen can't load, it now shows the same message with a Retry button everywhere, including the Collection, Programs, Venues, Custom fields, Recently deleted, Sync review, the import screens and the online preview. A dance or program that no longer exists offers Back instead of leaving you on a bare message.
The "Select a program" pane now carries the small Caller's Compendium mark, as the "Select a dance" pane already did.
